title: Attack speed
wikitext:
{{redirect|Attack Speed|the passive skill|Attack Speed (passive skill)}}

'''Attack speed''' is a property of [[attack]] skills. In combination with [[action speed]], it determines the speed with which attack animations can be performed. 

==Mechanics==
Most attack skills receive their base attack time from the equipped [[weapon]]. Base attack time while [[unarmed]] is 0.83s, while shield skills such as {{il|Shield Crush}} receive a base attack time from their gem instead. Attack time is used to calculate the number of attacks per second, the typical measure of attack speed displayed on weapons and the character sheet.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/eved5m/questions_thread_january_29_2020/fgeate5/?context=1</ref> 

Attack speed modifiers can increase or decrease a skill's attacks per second. These modifiers only affect [[attack]]s. Other types of skills have their own speed stats, such as {{c|mod|#% increased Cast speed}} or {{c|mod|#% increased Warcry speed}}. Similar to other animations, the practical duration of attacks is also affected multiplicatively by [[action speed]] modifiers like [[Chill]] and [[Tailwind]]. 

[[Trigger]]ed attacks are instant, though they still have an attack time for the purpose of stats like {{c|mod|#% chance to deal Double Damage with Attacks if Attack Time is longer than 1 second}}. 

===Characters===
All [[character]]s have the following attack speed modifiers in their base [[stat]]s.
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = generic_stats.stat_text
|where = 
 generic_stats.name="Character"
 AND generic_stats.id LIKE "%attack_speed%"
 AND generic_stats.value > 0
|format=ul
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant attack speed bonuses.

===Attack speed===
These passive skills grant increased attack speed.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "attack_speed_+%"
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%attack%speed%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
